messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT — service=\"inference-queue-backlog\" severity=P0. page fired: sustained queue growth 230% over 5m, autoscaler not keeping pace. link: https://redwood.incidents/5647382910 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered alert -> Primary on-call page sent. PD incident: PD-564738. Escalation policy: inference-core -> on-call -> sre-lead.

sre_ella: ack. I'm taking the page and jumping into metrics now. looking at autoscaler logs and queue length.

oncall_tim: i'm on standby, grabbing current chart URLs. seeing avg_queue_wait ~ 12s, queued_requests ~ 8.2k. 95p latency on generation endpoints up to ~9.8s. any quick wins?

infra_jay: fyi provider API returned quota errors during scale attempts: 
```
E0512 14:03:02.123 kubelet.go:202] FailedCreatePod: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = QuotaExceeded: cannot allocate spot instances
```
we're hitting regional spot spinup throttle on us-west-2.

product_leo: customer impact: several prod customers seeing timeouts (Acme, Brokerly). error rate rose 0.6% -> 3.4% in last 10m. support already triaging. recommend status page update if we can't stabilize in 15m.

support_ana: support has 5 active tickets referencing timeouts. customers asking for ETA. please add short note we can paste.

oncall_tim: runbook steps I'm running now:
1) try manual node pool bump to bypass autoscaler burst limit
2) switch to on-demand pool to avoid spot throttle
3) run kvcache warmup job to reduce cold-prefix latency
commands: 
```
# manual increase
kubectl scale deployment/inference-workers -n prod --replicas=60
# or bump nodepool
gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-infer-ondemand --size 10 --region us-west2
# kickoff warmup
kubectl create job warmup-kv --image=redwood/kvcache-warmup:stable -- env=\"PREFIX_LIST=/top-1000-prompts\"
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty: automatic escalation sent to sre-lead (no ack within 2m).

infra_jay: I manually resized the on-demand pool +8 nodes and forced a set of new instances. switched provisioning mode to on-demand for this pool. watch for increased costs.

sre_ella: seeing queue length drop: queued_requests 8200 -> 3200 in 4m, avg_wait 12s -> 5.6s. warmup job running, kvcache hit-rate slowly rising. good short-term improvement.

oncall_tim: nice. still seeing a couple of stuck pods with CrashLoopBackoff from an upstream model adapter; i'll restart pods matching label adapter=stable.

infra_jay: restarted adapters. also opened provider support ticket for quota bump: TKT-9987. asked for temporary throttle lift while we stabilize.

product_leo: please prepare a 1-2 line status we can post: \"We’re experiencing elevated request queues causing higher latencies for some generation requests. Engineers are actively scaling capacity and verifying caches; mitigation in progress.\" once we confirm the queue is below threshold we can close PD.

sre_ella: notes for next steps (I'll own follow-up):
- short-term: keep on-demand pool increased until autoscaler policy adjusted
- medium: update autoscaler burst_limit and backoff policy (increase scale-out aggressiveness for queued_requests signals)
- long-term: add provider quota pre-warming and alternate-region fallback routing
- postmortem: collect run duration, scale events, kvcache miss rates, provider throttle traces

oncall_tim: handing off to @sre_ella for night coverage in 20m. i'll leave the manual pools in place and document commands in the PD incident. :thumbsup:

support_ana: copying the status note to customers now. will add link to incident page once you confirm.

sre_ella: confirmed we can de-escalate PD after queue < 1k and error rate trends down. current metrics: queued_requests 1200, 95p latency 3.1s, error rate 0.9%. marking incident as mitigated but leaving follow-up tasks.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD-564738 acknowledged and marked mitigated by sre_ella. Please follow post-incident checklist and schedule RCA.

product_leo: schedule RCA meeting for tomorrow, include infra + autoscaler owners + product. will draft customer follow-up once RCA has root cause.

sre_ella: action items created: INFRA-231 (quota request), SRE-912 (autoscaler policy patch), RCA-5647. attaching quick notes to the PD incident. signing off from live handover.

oncall_tim: thanks team, great triage. leaving traces/commands in incident timeline.

support_ana: customers updated. closing front-line tickets as mitigated where applicable.

# end of thread
